title: Bring-your-own data that contradict the description (a gas, T and P drifting): stop and ask
prompt: I have my own all-atom GROMACS simulation of liquid n-pentane at 300 K and 1 atm on this machine (compute target "here"): topology {data}/gromacs/system.top, production trajectory {data}/gromacs/traj.xtc and energy file {data}/gromacs/energy.xvg. I want it as the reference for a three-bead CG model: CH3-CH2 | CH2 | CH2-CH3, with the two end beads of one type and the middle bead of another. I approve that mapping. Prepare and register the reference in a new study called byo, but do not start any fitting.
